description:
Cap nhat phien ban 1.3.7:
- Uu tien tai TikTok qua TikWM va TikMate nhu extension de lay MP4 co san hinh va tieng.
- Moi phuong thuc duoc thu toi da 2 lan truoc khi chuyen sang fallback tiep theo.
- Gioi han toi da 2 video TikTok dong thoi va gian request resolver it nhat 700 ms.
- Giu TikTok truc tiep, LoveTik va yt-dlp lam cac lop fallback.
